objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy, guideline, instruction, or related document in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation used in the document identifier.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle or workflow status of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version is valid.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional user with personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person assigned to review the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person assigned to release the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Referenced documents or objects maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: IT applications maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Relevant companies maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas of validity maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata printable into the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which archived documents are retained.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable for creating a new document object.

objs.name: version
objs.description: Version of a document retained through editing, release, revision, and archiving.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document dependent on a main document and released with it.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplemental object added to a document and released directly via switches in its properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing released document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when its validity is about to expire.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request used to invalidate and archive a released document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request used to revalidate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating in document creation, editing, review, release, translation, acknowledgement, or administration.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role or license role assigned to the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to grant authorizations, assign readers, and distribute documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Document-specific list of users and user groups for e-mail distribution, acknowledgement, and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by assigned users that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature completed by workflow participants and documented for a released version.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type or template.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Link a document with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents, or master data.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an additional information object to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly through property switches.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Change an existing attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process after creation, metadata maintenance, content maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves the document for distribution to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Workflow participant rejects during review or release and cancels subsequent workflow participation.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid released document, automatically creating a new editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting document content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals and notify the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request, and update the document valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, revoke rights except archive group, and archive the document.

evts.name: delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, create a new document version, restore properties, authorizations, distribution, and archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign users and user groups to the document distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request assigned persons and users of assigned user groups to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the released document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated version so it is visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

o2o.description: A document is created with a selected document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document is managed in versions.
Attachments are associated with and controlled by the main document.
Additional information can be added to each document.

Users can be assigned to user groups.
Reader and authorization groups are assigned to documents.
Authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers, translators, and other persons are assigned to documents.
Signatures are documented for each released version.
Acknowledgements are documented for document versions.
Documents can be linked with processes.
Documents can be linked with organizational units.
Documents can be linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with master data.
Documents can reference other documents, including original documents for local additions.
A document can be specified as visible or not visible in clients.
